CFO Native Board

This product includes adapted portions of Cline Kanban, Copyright 2026 Cline Bot Inc.
Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
License: /assets/cline-kanban-LICENSE.txt
Source: https://github.com/cline/kanban/tree/abd4912c27ce6b7f18b5a8106c145fd838e90cc4

Modified files and behavior:
Board.tsx adapts kanban-board.tsx grouping into evidence-backed Tasks, In progress and Completed columns.
diff.ts and syntax.tsx adapt patch parsing and language selection from shared/diff-renderer.tsx.
Details.tsx adapts on-demand commit selection and diff presentation from git-history-view.tsx, plus contextual line feedback from detail-panels/diff-viewer-panel.tsx.
stream.ts adapts bounded reconnection from runtime/use-runtime-state-stream.ts.
CFO removes drag-to-progress, automation creation and destructive Git controls; adds durable Go actions, pipeline custody checks, two-sided line coordinates, safe text-token rendering, full SSE snapshots, and evidence-backed lineage.
The pinned upstream tree contains LICENSE and no NOTICE file.

Design tokens and card/ghost/focus primitives are adapted from the inspected local SIQshift packages/shared/styles/brand.css.
Rounded rectangle controls, the native select chevron/skin, and native details/summary styling are adapted from SIQshift apps/desktop/src/styles.css and the matching apps/web/src/styles.css controls.
Details.tsx adapts load-on-open and release-on-close disclosure behavior from packages/shared/src/ui.tsx ShiftGroups, using the existing CFO resource hook with stale-response cancellation.
CFO uses its own self-hosted typography, layered card surfaces, mutually exclusive Board/Orchestration views and one contextual pane; SIQshift reporting labels, charts, WebGL and API contracts are not included.
The app icon and three transparent goblin sprite atlases were generated with the built-in image generation tool for this project and approved by the user on 2026-09-22.
They were copied unchanged from the approved production assets; role-specific artwork is chosen deterministically from reported role or task wording, never presented as inferred runtime telemetry.
Runtime dependencies: React and React DOM (MIT), PrismJS (MIT), xterm.js and its fit addon (MIT).
React: https://github.com/facebook/react/blob/main/LICENSE
Prism: https://github.com/PrismJS/prism/blob/master/LICENSE

Bundled React and React DOM license: /assets/react-LICENSE.txt
Bundled PrismJS license: /assets/prism-LICENSE.txt
Bundled xterm.js 6.0.0 license: /assets/xterm-LICENSE.txt
Bundled xterm.js fit addon 0.11.0 license: /assets/xterm-fit-LICENSE.txt

Fonts, self-hosted as unmodified latin subsets under the SIL Open Font License 1.1:
Pixelify Sans, Copyright 2021 The Pixelify Sans Project Authors (https://github.com/eifetx/Pixelify-Sans). License: /assets/fonts/pixelify-sans-OFL.txt
Nunito, Copyright 2014 The Nunito Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/nunito). License: /assets/fonts/nunito-OFL.txt
JetBrains Mono, Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors (https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono). License: /assets/fonts/jetbrains-mono-OFL.txt
The terminal renderer and fit addon load only for the Orchestration native terminal view.

The goblin workshop canvas background was generated for this project and approved by the user on 2026-09-23.
